summary: The change removes the private 50-target cap in `parseChildRuntimeSummary` and reuses `TARGETS_MAX` (64) from `src/host/targets.ts`, so target lists up to the validated configuration bound are retained. A regression test runs 51 and 64 targets through `emitRunSummary`, asserting the aggregated JSON targets and the Markdown rows retain every target, and no other 50-target truncation remains in the run-summary path.

evidence: src/host/run-summary.ts:149 slices child target rows to TARGETS_MAX (64) instead of the removed MAX_TARGETS = 50
tests/host/run-summary_test.ts:271-321 asserts 51 and TARGETS_MAX targets all appear with their counts in the aggregated summary JSON and step summary
